_note: S223 - the launch tile set, per the owner's rulings at the S223 open. CHANGES FROM v1: (1) darpan's mask is GONE - he sees the same operational layer as everyone else. (2) Daily Sale, Vaapsi Desk and the NEW Stock Check tile are granted BY NAME here; in portal.py they carry roles ['doctor'] only. That is deliberate: if this file is ever missing or malformed, staff lose those three money screens (fail closed) and the doctor keeps everything (never locked out). Everything else - Scan Purchase, Staff Register, Attendance, Forms & Downloads - is untouched and stays on the staff role. This file decides what a person is SHOWN.
